_comment: Kia 'Seltos follow-up' scripted demo flow (see Automotive note). Gated to KIA_PHONE. Flow: nudge -> profile + 3 offer banners (pick one) -> proactive exchange-bonus add-on -> add contact -> anything-else (free text) -> generate first banner -> localize to Hindi + on-road price. 'progress' messages stream a beat apart (GEN_STEP_DELAY_MS). Swap the Scene7 banner URLs / contact number as needed. Engine: src/scriptedFlow.js.
